# 1. Destiny Mission Progress (0..110, country scope)
oe_ux2_val_destiny_progress = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { oe_ux2_is_destiny_power_trigger = yes } add = 10 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_msn_active_pack } add = 25 }
	if = { limit = { oe_ux2_is_destiny_completed_trigger = yes } add = 65 }
	if = { limit = { has_any_mission_active = yes } add = 10 }
}

		value = var:oe_ent_index
	}
}

# 4. Great Canals Built (country scope, strictly O(1) landmark + variable checks)
oe_ux2_val_great_canals = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { capital ?= { is_canal_open = yes } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { var:oe_lgr_corinth ?= 3 } add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage
			var:oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage >= 3
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_red_canal_stage
			OR = { global_var:oe_red_canal_stage ?= 3 global_var:oe_red_canal_stage ?= 9 }
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
				has_or_had_tag = MAM
				has_or_had_tag = EGY
				has_or_had_tag = TUR
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:suez
			location:suez = {
				OR = {
					is_canal_open = yes
					has_building = building_type:oe_egypt_canal
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:hangzhou
			location:hangzhou = { has_building = building_type:oe_wnd_hangzhou_canal_hub }
		}
		add = 1
	}
}

# 9. Golden Horde / Chagatai / Yuan Cohesion (0..100, country scope)
oe_ux2_val_steppe_yuan_cohesion = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_or_had_tag = GLH
			has_global_variable = oe_ghh_cohesion
		}
		value = global_var:oe_ghh_cohesion
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { has_or_had_tag = CHG has_or_had_tag = TIM }
			has_global_variable = oe_chg2_authority
		}
		value = global_var:oe_chg2_authority
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_loyalty }
		value = var:oe_yp_loyalty
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { has_or_had_tag = CHI has_or_had_tag = YUA has_or_had_tag = MNG }
			exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		}
		value = government_power
	}
}

# 10. Granary Reserve Tier (0..5, country scope)
oe_ux2_val_granary_reserve = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = village_granary
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = granary
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = fortress_granary
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = granary
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = fortress_granary
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { capital ?= { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = fortress_granary } }
		add = 1
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_clim_crops_adopted } add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = oe_clim_granary_relief_mod
				has_country_modifier = oe_clim_bread_assize_mod
				has_country_modifier = oe_clim_crown_potato_estates_mod
				has_country_modifier = oe_clim_lia_state_stockpiles_mod
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
}

# 13. Climate & Epidemic Resilience Index (0..100, country scope)
oe_ux2_val_climate_resilience = {

	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_clim_crops_adopted } add = 20 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dis_quarantine_triumph } add = 20 }
	if = { limit = { capital ?= { has_any_disease_present = yes } } add = -20 }
	if = { limit = { capital ?= { area = { has_extended_winter = yes } } } add = -15 }
	if = { limit = { capital ?= { province = { is_starving = yes } } } add = -15 }
	min = 0
	max = 100
}

	value = num_embraced_institutions
